відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"For a walk to work in deep frost and snow, I built the outfit around warm layers: the coat over the knit sweater, with the beanie for the 20 minutes outside. The boots and the bag carry the same soft brown tones, so the outfit stays calm and tidy. The knit set is a little softer than a strict office look, so I chose the coat to keep the whole outfit neat. If the roads are salted, the suede of the boots and the bag could suffer, so wipe them once you arrive. I'm not sure how the boot soles grip on ice, so shorten your steps on slick patches.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wear the coat over everything for the walk and keep the beanie on until you reach the office.\",\"If the roads were salted, wipe the suede boots and the bag with a slightly damp cloth as soon as you arrive, then let them dry away from the radiator.\",\"On icy stretches, take short, flat steps in the boots, since I can't confirm how well the soles grip.\"],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#38·29\",\"what\":\"coat\"},{\"n\":\"#34·18\",\"what\":\"beanie\"},{\"n\":\"#26·08\",\"what\":\"suede boots\"},{\"n\":\"#139·07\",\"what\":\"suede bag\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#142·00\",\"text\":\"The knit set is here for its comfortable, tidy everyday level, which suits a workday. It sits a little below a strict office look, and I chose it on purpose for warmth and ease on the walk.\"},{\"n\":\"#21·28\",\"text\":\"The sweater is here because its knit suits deep frost and its level fits a working day.\"},{\"n\":\"#38·29\",\"text\":\"The coat is here for the deep frost. Its wool is declared in the composition, which ranks it higher for the cold, and its level suits the office.\"},{\"n\":\"#26·08\",\"text\":\"I chose these boots on purpose for their level, which fits the office. The suede may suffer if the roads are salted, so wipe it after the walk. I'm not sure how the sole grips on ice.\"},{\"n\":\"#139·07\",\"text\":\"I chose this bag on purpose to finish the outfit. Its suede may suffer if the roads are salted, so wipe it dry when you get to work.\"},{\"n\":\"#34·18\",\"text\":\"The beanie is here because its knit suits the deep frost and keeps your head warm on a 20-minute walk.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":19862,"output_tokens":1684},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
